messages:
mira: FYI console invoice preview shows ~3% more tokens for some tenants after the routing policy rollout last night. eyeballing routing logs now.

sam: Which tenants? any common routing tag or model alias?

mira: Mostly mid-market customers on route-tag 'beta-route'. sample tenant ids: t-304, t-411, t-522.

josh: I pulled invoice events for t-304 — looks like a handful of billing events missing the enrichment join_key after enrich-service upgrade. events still have token_count but no route_attr in invoice_event.

nina: Confirming: preview pipeline uses sparse sampling (0.1) for perf, but invoice pipeline is full. Are we sure preview vs final diverged? :thinking:

rahul: Canary used new fallback priority routing (hysteresis) which changes which route attribute we attach early vs late. If enrichment sees request before final routing, join_key could be empty.

mira: That matches the trace: request flowed through edge -> fallback-router (old) -> enrich (v2) -> final-router (new). enrich got a null route_tag.

sam: So attribution moved later in the path. Two quick fixes: 1) make enrich idempotently enrich from request headers (fallback to route cookie) or 2) ensure routing sets provisional attributes earlier. Which is lower blast radius?

josh: Option 1 is safe short-term. Patch in enrich: if route_attr missing, try header X-Route-Provisional or compute join_key := sha256(clientid + sessionid). Example SQL we use for joins: SELECT invoice_id FROM events WHERE join_key = 'abc' AND ts >= ...

nina: For previews we can temporarily bump sampling to 1.0 for affected tenants so console reflects final invoice counts while patch is rolling. downside: more load on preview recompute job.

metering-bot: [log] enrich/v2 WARN missing route_attr for request=ae3f4 cost=12 tokens=84 path=edge->fallback-router->enrich

rahul: timeline: small patch to enrich (backfill header/provisional) + preview sampling bump for 2 hours. deploy to canary tonight, monitor invoice-delta metric.

sam: Can we also add a lightweight invariant check in the pipeline that emits an alert if invoice_event.route_attr is null but token_count > 0? Helps catch regressions early.

josh: I'll add a rule to event-validator (low severity) and a dashboard card: 'invoice_events with null route_attr by tenant' + rate chart.

mira: Action items: josh to ship enrich fallback patch (PR by EOD), nina to increase preview sampling for tenant set (will run for 2h), sam to add invariant alert, rahul to run canary and monitor. I'll coordinate with CS to avoid noisy alerts for affected customers.

nina: Quick note on UX: console should surface a subtle banner when preview sampling is temporarily elevated so PMs know preview isn't the default. I'll add a short copy.

rahul: If we see deltas persist after fix, next step is a reconciliation job: join invoice_events -> raw-requests by session window and recompute attribution. That is heavier but safe.

mira: Sounds good. Thanks all. ping me in #oncall if any alert fires during canary. :thumbsup:
